citations.claim: energy at first violation exceeds allowed

counterfactual.change: set body 1 restitution e from 1.0 to 0.0; removes spurious energy gain

explanation: Shrunk 2-body high-speed collision gains spurious energy at step 26. Energy ~2933J until step 25 then jumps to 19061J at step 26 exceeding allowed 3231J with zero controller work. Velocities explode (body0 speed 9->51). Changing only body1 restitution 1.0->0 removes energy explosion, implicating impulse/restitution handling with positional correction.
vision_note: In steps 23-25 the two blue bodies approach each other with a small gap that steadily closes on the right side of the arena. At step 26 they make contact and appear to interpenetrate/overlap at the collision instant, marking a sudden impulsive event with no other visible bodies, walls or waypoints involved.
